title: kOA Governance Policy Bundle
description: Validates a signed, versioned governance policy bundle consumed by Governance Policy Runtime. A conforming bundle declares deterministic policy modules, facts, outcomes, reason codes, obligations, review and recourse paths, compatibility, activation, rollback, offline behavior, tests, provenance, approvals, and signatures. The schema does not grant activation authority; lifecycle and Release Set validation remain required.

semantic_rules: Identifiers within each catalog are unique and permanently reserved after publication.
Every rule references a declared fact, reason code, obligation, and review requirement.
Every module domain appears in manifest.policy_domains.
Every declared required test category has at least one executable test vector.
Validated, staged, active, and recovery-eligible bundles have complete passing evidence.
The bundle is activated only as part of a compatible four-channel Release Set.
Policy evaluation is deterministic and side-effect free.
Missing facts cannot produce implicit allow.
No module allocates CPU, memory, I/O, queue, or worker capacity.
No rule directly mutates component authoritative state or grants host privilege.
Emergency policy expires automatically and receives post-event review.
Published bundle content is immutable; changes use a new artifact identity or version.
